summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Novo Nordisk A/S reporting a positive CHMP opinion recommending marketing authorisation for Wegovy pill (oral semaglutide) for weight management in the EU. The filing describes clinical trial results and regulatory progress, not a corporate special situation. It is a routine regulatory update on a drug approval recommendation, with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change announced.
